item.title: What forced the US to ground all planes? A router switch, we now know
item.description: US officials say a routine upgrade that went awry caused the mass disruption of air travel.

item.title: India pulled 500m people out of poverty. Many of them still barely survive
item.description: World Bank says India pulled a record number of citizens out of poverty, but millions of them still live on the edge.

item.title: Thousands in Portugal protest against surging rental prices
item.description: Thousands of people across Portugal are angry about rising rental prices, demanding action to end the housing crisis.

item.title: De la Fuente denies racism in Spain despite Yamal, Vinicius avowals
item.description: Yamal and Vinicius have publicly said they face racist abuse in Spain, which has faced FIFA punishment over the issue.

item.title: Jordan sentences three men to death by hanging after deadly church attack
item.description: Three men have been convicted of carrying out an attack on a church in the Karak governorate that killed nine people.

item.title: Pact on South China Sea code of conduct unlikely, as ASEAN leaders gather
item.description: Finishing negotiations for disputed South China Sea agreement will be a 'tall order', analysts say.

item.title: Japan stun Brazil 3-2 in stoppage time as Ancelotti, Raphinha sent off
item.description: Substitute Tatsuhiro Sakamoto’s late goal helps Japan avenge their defeat by Brazil in the World Cup round of 32.

item.title: ASEAN summit: Who’s attending and what’s at stake?
item.description: Energy disruptions as a result of the US-Israel war on Iran is a key issue for the import-dependent bloc.

item.title: Israel: Making the Holy Land burn
item.description: For all its greenwashing, the Zionist state has ecologically devastated Palestine more than anyone else.

item.title: The French Republic’s forgotten promise of equality
item.description: French youth learn in school about the Revolution’s values but they do not see them reflected in their own reality.

item.title: Secret votes and vetoes: How will the next UN chief be picked?
item.description: With no frontrunner for the job, eight candidates are vying for the UN Security Council's recommendation.

item.title: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift
item.description: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda clash over who should lead the organisation of French-speaking nations.

item.title: New York Democratic Socialists urge Ocasio-Cortez to run for US president
item.description: Delegates at NYC-DSA convention pass resolution formally calling on Congresswoman AOC to run in 2028 presidential race.

item.title: Video shows moment of Brooklyn building collapse from inside
item.description: Newly released nanny cam footage shows the moment an apartment building collapsed in Brooklyn as children played inside.

item.title: Zimbabwe’s HIV gains face a test among young people
item.description: New prevention tools offer hope, but reaching young people remains a challenge.

item.title: Monkey attacks woman inside residential complex in India
item.description: A woman was attacked and repeatedly bitten by a monkey at a residential apartment complex in India’s Gujarat state.

item.title: Italian artist reimagines Madonna paintings to expose Gaza’s pain
item.description: Italian artist Eduardo Castaldo has unveiled an artwork titled ‘Holy Mothers of Gaza’ inside Naples’ Pappacoda Chapel.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts suspected Houthi missiles and drones
item.description: Fighting escalates in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf, as UN agency says more than 340,000 Yemenis displaced since August.

item.title: Iraq PM sacks nine officials over oil smuggling in pro-Iran stronghold
item.description: Dismissals follow probe that uncovered illegal oil refineries and smuggling in a region run by Kataib Hezbollah.

item.title: Netanyahu sends plea to Eisenkot for unity government
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu has issued a public plea to opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a unity government.

item.title: Thailand’s elderly kept in cages
item.description: A nursing home in Thailand, has been accused of keeping dozens of senior residents, in metal cages.

item.title: SpaceX’s Starship nails a smooth return with historic catch
item.description: SpaceX Starship made a triumphant return to Earth, caught midair by giant mechanical ‘chopsticks’.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza
item.description: Hamas confirms the death of Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis in an attack on Khan Younis on Saturday.

item.title: Hundreds of men march in Switzerland to protest violence against women
item.description: Organisers say men must speak out, as Swiss study finds half of men aged 18 to 24 hold restrictive view of masculinity.

item.title: SpaceX’s Starship captured by launchpad arms in dramatic first
item.description: SpaceX officials say catch by mechanical arms shows Starship's full reusability, crucial for rapid, low-cost recycling.
